title: Oven Roasted Saudi Arabian Egg Noodles
description: A yeasty, aerated, romantic Saudi Arabian dish featuring egg noodles, robata grill, and low fat friendly ingredients, served on a cedar plank.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, garlic, ginger, cumin, coriander, salt, and black pepper.
Add the egg noodles to the bowl and toss to coat with the oil mixture.
In a small bowl, proof the yeast by mixing it with 1 tablespoon of warm water.
Add the yeast mixture to the noodles and toss to combine.
Line a cedar plank with parchment paper and arrange the noodles in a single layer.
Place the cedar plank on a robata grill or a baking sheet and roast in the oven for 15 minutes.
Remove the noodles from the oven and serve hot.
Garnish with chopped fresh parsley or cilantro, if desired.
